name: Cheque
definition: Negotiable instrument instructing a financial institution to pay a specific amount of a specific currency from the account of the drawer with that institution.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a cheque as assigned by the financial institution.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date when the draft becomes payable and the debtor's account is debited.

FormsCode.name: Forms Code
FormsCode.definition: Code agreed between the initiating party and the debtor's agent, that specifies the cheque layout, company logo and digitised signature to be used to print the cheque.

MemoField.name: Memo Field
MemoField.definition: Information that needs to be printed on a cheque, used by the payer to add miscellaneous information.

RegionalClearingZone.name: Regional Clearing Zone
RegionalClearingZone.definition: Regional area in which the cheque can be cleared, when a country has no nation-wide cheque clearing organisation.

ChequeDelivery.name: Cheque Delivery
ChequeDelivery.definition: Specifies the parameters related to the delivery of the cheque.

ChequePartyRole.name: Cheque Party Role
ChequePartyRole.definition: Specifies each role played by a party in the process of paying by cheque.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Cash account on which a cheque is drawn.
